run_transcoder_translation: run the transcoder translation pipeline to translate Java functions to Python or C++ using a trained model
compute_transcoder_translation: compute beam search translations of Java functions to a target language using a neural transcoder model
get_joined_func_tests_df: join a test CSV file with Java function token files into a merged DataFrame by function ID
parse_arguments: parse CLI arguments for the transcoder translation pipeline including model path, BPE path, and target language
main: orchestrate chunked transcoder translation of Java functions with local or cluster execution via submitit
